title: The set of matchings avoiding a short-chord-free pattern is closed under Knuth equivalence
author: Avichai Marmor
work: Schur-positivity of short chords in matchings
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 1300-1303: for a short-chord-free matching m, the set of matchings of given size and number of unmatched vertices that avoid m is closed under Knuth equivalence. The proof (source lines 1304-1307) reduces to a single elementary Knuth transformation, then takes a witness for the containment of m in the original matching and has to rebuild it for the transformed matching; the reconstruction splits into two cases according to whether the vertex moved by the transformation is part of the witness, and both cases are only non-degenerate because the pattern has no short chord. The statement records the closure property and neither the reduction nor the case analysis.
